<html lang="id">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Keuangan Paguyuban Griya Mulya</title>
<link rel="canonical" href="https://vriyamath221193.github.io/vriya-perum-gm/">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#003d79">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bricolage+Grotesque:wght@600;700&family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{color-scheme:light;--bg:#f3f6fb;--sf:#fff;--ink:#0f2447;--mute:#5b6b88;--line:#dbe4f3;--pri:#1d5fd6;--on:#fff;--btnbg:linear-gradient(180deg,#2f72ea,#1d5fd6);--bglow:0 1px 2px rgba(29,95,214,.3);--in:#1d5fd6;--out:#d64562;--c1:#1d5fd6;--c2:#e04545;--c3:#17a05d;--sb:#fff;--hl:#eaf1fd;--tb:#0f2447;--tt:linear-gradient(90deg,#123d9f,#1d5fd6);--tbg:#fff;--tbg2:#f4f8ff;--th:#1b56c9;--thc:#fff;--tsal:#eaf1fd;--sgl:0px;--psh:0 1px 2px rgba(15,36,71,.05),0 8px 20px -10px rgba(15,36,71,.14);--tglow:none;--bgimg:none;
box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
button,input,select{font-family:inherit}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bgimg),var(--bg);background-attachment:fixed;color:var(--ink);font:400 15px/1.55 "Plus Jakarta Sans",system-ui,sans-serif}
.app{display:flex;min-height:100vh}
aside{width:236px;flex:none;background:var(--sb);border-right:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--mute);padding:22px 14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:24px;position:sticky;top:0;height:100vh;align-self:flex-start}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:0 4px}
.mark{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:11px;background:var(--btnbg);box-shadow:var(--bglow);display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none}
.bn{font:700 18px "Bricolage Grotesque",sans-serif;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.2}.bs{font-size:12px}
nav{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
nav button{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:none;border:0;color:inherit;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;text-align:left}
nav button:hover{background:var(--hl)}nav button[aria-selected=true]{background:var(--hl);color:var(--pri);box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 var(--pri)}
.foot{margin-top:auto;font-size:12px}.foot p{margin:0 0 6px}
.lnk{background:none;border:0;color:var(--pri);text-decoration:underline;font-size:12px;padding:0;cursor:pointer}
main{flex:1;min-width:0;max-width:1060px;padding:30px 30px 56px;margin:0 auto}
.head{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:14px;margin-bottom:20px}
h1,h2,.big{font-family:"Bricolage Grotesque",system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.015em;margin:0}
h1{font-size:28px;line-height:1.15}h2{font-size:17px;margin:26px 0 10px}
.sub{color:var(--mute);font-size:13px;margin:2px 0 0}
.act{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.mn{display:flex;align-items:center;background:var(--sf);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px}
.mn select{border:0;background:none;font-weight:600;padding:8px 4px;color:var(--ink)}
.ic{border:0;background:none;color:var(--ink);font-size:20px;line-height:1;padding:6px 11px;cursor:pointer;border-radius:8px}.ic:disabled{opacity:.3;cursor:default}
.btn{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;background:var(--btnbg);color:var(--on);border:1px solid transparent;box-shadow:var(--bglow);border-radius:9px;padding:9px 15px;cursor:pointer}
.btn.ghost{background:var(--sf);color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--line);box-shadow:none}
button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,select:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--pri);outline-offset:2px}
.panel{background:var(--sf);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;box-shadow:var(--psh)}
.hero{padding:22px 24px;border-top:3px solid var(--pri)}.hero .big{font-size:clamp(34px,7vw,50px);font-weight:700;line-height:1.05;margin:4px 0 6px;text-shadow:var(--tglow)}
.seg{display:flex;height:12px;border-radius:6px;gap:3px;margin:18px 0 12px}.seg i{display:block;min-width:2px;border-radius:6px}
.lg{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 26px;list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0;font-size:13px}
.lg li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}.lg .dot{margin:0}
.dot{display:inline-block;width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;margin-right:8px;flex:none}
.tw{overflow-x:auto}
table{border-collapse:separate;border-spacing:0;width:100%;min-width:640px}
th,td{padding:12px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:14px;text-align:left;vertical-align:top}
th{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--thc);background:var(--th);white-space:nowrap;padding-top:13px;padding-bottom:13px}
tbody tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0}tbody tr:not(.tt):not(.aw):hover td{background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(29,95,214,.06),rgba(29,95,214,.06))}
.n{text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;white-space:nowrap}.in{color:var(--in)}.out{color:var(--out)}.b{font-weight:600}
td,td.in,td.out{color:var(--tb)}
td.dt{color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--tb) 75%,var(--sf));white-space:nowrap;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
th.in,th.out{color:var(--thc)}th.in{box-shadow:inset 0 -2px 0 #9fe3ff}th.out{box-shadow:inset 0 -2px 0 #ffb3c0}
tr.tt td{font-weight:700;background:var(--tt);color:#fff;border-bottom:0}tr.aw td{background:var(--tsal);color:var(--tb);font-weight:600}
.chart{padding:18px 20px}
.bars{display:flex;gap:10px;height:180px}
.bc{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:4px;height:100%;border:0;background:none;color:var(--mute);font-size:12px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;opacity:.55;padding:0}
.bc small{font-size:11px;font-weight:400}.bc.on{opacity:1;color:var(--ink);font-weight:700}
.pair{flex:1;width:100%;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;gap:4px;min-height:0}
.pair i{width:38%;max-width:24px;border-radius:4px 4px 0 0;min-height:2px}
.bi{background:var(--in);box-shadow:0 0 var(--sgl) var(--in)}.bo{background:var(--out);box-shadow:0 0 var(--sgl) var(--out)}
.lgd{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px 18px;margin-top:14px;font-size:13px;align-items:center}.lgd i{display:inline-block;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:3px;margin-right:6px}
.tabs{display:inline-flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px;background:var(--sf);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:4px;margin-bottom:14px}
.tabs button{display:flex;align-items:center;border:0;background:none;color:var(--mute);font-size:14px;font-weight:500;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:7px;cursor:pointer}
.tabs button[aria-selected=true]{background:var(--hl);color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--c1),0 0 12px -2px var(--c1)}
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(150px,1fr));margin-bottom:14px}
.stats div{padding:14px 18px;border-right:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;flex-direction:column}.stats div:last-child{border:0}
.stats span{font-size:13px;color:var(--mute)}.stats b{font:700 19px "Bricolage Grotesque",sans-serif;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.empty{text-align:center;color:var(--mute);padding:26px}
.del{border:0;background:none;color:var(--mute);font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:6px}.del:hover{color:var(--out);background:var(--hl)}
input,select{font-size:15px;color:var(--ink);background:var(--sf);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:9px 10px;min-width:0}
dialog{border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--psh);border-radius:14px;padding:22px;width:min(520px,92vw);background:var(--sf);color:var(--ink)}dialog::backdrop{background:rgba(15,36,71,.45)}
dialog h2{margin:0}.fg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;margin:16px 0 20px}
.fg label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;font-size:13px;color:var(--mute)}.fg .w{grid-column:1/-1}.fg small{min-height:1.2em;color:var(--in);font-weight:600}
.da{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:8px}
#toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:calc(24px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));transform:translate(-50%,16px);background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);padding:10px 18px;border-radius:99px;font-size:14px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.2s;z-index:40}
#toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#toast{transition:none}}
.ph{display:none}
@media (max-width:859px){.app{display:block}aside{position:static;width:auto;height:auto;padding:14px 16px;flex-direction:row;align-items:center}.foot{display:none}
nav{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:20;flex-direction:row;background:var(--sb);padding:6px 10px calc(6px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));gap:6px}
nav button{flex:1;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:3px;font-size:12px;padding:8px}main{padding:20px 16px 100px}.fg{grid-template-columns:1fr}#toast{bottom:calc(84px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))}}
@media print{aside,.act,.tabs,.km,.noprint,#toast,.tw::after{display:none!important}.ph{display:block;margin-bottom:14px}body{background:#fff;color:#000}.app{display:block}main{padding:0}}
.cw{overflow-x:auto}.cv{display:block;min-width:560px;width:100%;height:auto}.cv text{font-family:"Plus Jakarta Sans",sans-serif}
.gl{stroke:var(--line);stroke-width:1;stroke-dasharray:3 5}.ax{fill:var(--mute);font-size:11px}.ax.on{fill:var(--ink);font-weight:700}.vl{fill:var(--ink);font-size:10px;font-weight:600}.sv{fill:var(--tb);font-size:10px}.sel{fill:var(--hl)}
table{background:var(--tbg)}
tbody tr:nth-child(even):not(.tt):not(.aw) td{background:var(--tbg2)}
tbody tr:not(.tt):not(.aw) td.b{background:var(--tsal)}
.pk th{vertical-align:middle}.pk .grp{text-align:center;box-shadow:inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.4)}.pk thead th.sub2{font-weight:500}
.pk td{padding-top:15px;padding-bottom:15px;vertical-align:middle}
.cur{font-size:11px;opacity:.6;margin-right:4px;font-weight:500}.z{opacity:.45}
.kb{display:inline-block;width:4px;height:22px;border-radius:2px;vertical-align:middle;margin-right:12px}.kn{font-weight:600;vertical-align:middle}
.sa{font-weight:700;font-size:15px}.tk{height:4px;border-radius:2px;background:#dbe6fb;margin-top:7px;overflow:hidden;min-width:110px}.tk i{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:2px}
.km{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;margin-bottom:16px}
.kc{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;text-align:left;padding:14px 16px 14px 20px;background:var(--sf);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:border-color .15s,box-shadow .15s}
.kc::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:4px;background:var(--kc);opacity:.5}
.kc:hover{border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--kc) 55%,var(--line))}
.kc[aria-selected=true]{border-color:var(--kc);background:linear-gradient(135deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--kc) 9%,var(--sf)),var(--sf));box-shadow:0 6px 18px -10px var(--kc)}
.kc[aria-selected=true]::before{opacity:1}
.kt{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--mute)}.kc[aria-selected=true] .kt{color:var(--ink)}
.kd{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--kc)}
.ks{font:700 21px "Bricolage Grotesque",sans-serif;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;letter-spacing:-.01em}.kl{font-size:12px;color:var(--mute)}
@media (max-width:859px){.km{grid-template-columns:none;grid-auto-flow:column;grid-auto-columns:minmax(230px,80%);overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:6px;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory}.kc{scroll-snap-align:start}}
th,td{border-bottom-color:rgba(15,36,71,.08)}
.ro{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px 16px;margin-top:12px;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:13px}.ro i{display:inline-block;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:3px;margin-right:6px}
@media (max-width:859px){.cv{min-width:0}.km{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);grid-auto-flow:row;grid-auto-columns:auto;overflow:visible;padding-bottom:0;scroll-snap-type:none;gap:8px}.kc{padding:10px 8px 10px 12px;border-radius:10px}.kt{font-size:clamp(9px,2.6vw,13px)}.ks{font-size:clamp(10px,3.1vw,17px)}.kl{display:none}}
@media (max-width:640px){
main{padding:14px 10px 96px}h1{font-size:22px}h2{font-size:15px;margin:20px 0 8px}
.head{gap:10px;margin-bottom:14px}.act{width:100%}.act .btn{flex:1;padding:9px 8px}.mn{flex:1;justify-content:space-between}.mn select{flex:1;text-align:center}
table{min-width:0;width:100%;font-size:clamp(10px,2.85vw,13px)}th,td{padding:8px 5px;font-size:inherit}th{font-size:clamp(9px,2.5vw,12px);white-space:normal}
.pk td{padding-top:10px;padding-bottom:10px}.pk .sa{font-size:inherit}.tk{min-width:0;margin-top:5px}.kb{width:3px;height:18px;margin-right:6px}
.cur{display:none}.tw::after{content:"Angka dalam rupiah (Rp)";display:block;padding:6px 10px;font-size:10px;color:var(--mute);background:var(--tbg);border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.hero{padding:16px}.chart{padding:14px 10px}.sv{font-size:9px}.ax{font-size:10px}
.stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.stats div{border-right:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:12px 14px}.stats div:nth-child(2n){border-right:0}.stats div:last-child{border-bottom:0}.stats div:last-child:nth-child(odd){grid-column:1/-1;border-right:0}.stats b{font-size:16px}
.lg{gap:6px 14px}}
h2{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}h2::before{content:"";width:4px;height:16px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--pri);flex:none}dialog h2::before{display:none}
@media (max-width:859px){aside{border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}nav{border-top:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:0 -6px 18px -10px rgba(15,36,71,.2)}nav button[aria-selected=true]{box-shadow:inset 0 3px 0 var(--pri);border-radius:0 0 8px 8px}}
.k3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px}
.tl{position:relative;padding:12px 14px 12px 19px;border-radius:10px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--kc) 8%,var(--sf));border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--kc) 30%,var(--line));overflow:hidden}
.tl::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:5px;background:var(--kc)}
.tn{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600}.tn i{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--kc);flex:none}
.tl b{display:block;font:700 clamp(12px,3.4vw,20px) "Bricolage Grotesque",sans-serif;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;margin:4px 0 2px}.tp{font-size:12px;color:var(--mute)}
.seg{height:14px}
@media (max-width:640px){.k3{gap:8px}.tl{padding:9px 7px 9px 12px}.tn{font-size:10px;gap:5px}.tn i{width:7px;height:7px}.tp{font-size:10px}.tl b{font-size:clamp(11px,3.3vw,16px)}}
.k4{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:12px;margin-bottom:16px}
.fbar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:12px}.fbar input{flex:1;min-width:180px;max-width:320px}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}
.chip{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--sf);color:var(--mute);border-radius:99px;padding:6px 12px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer}
.chip[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--pri);border-color:var(--pri);color:#fff}
.bd{display:inline-block;padding:2px 10px;border-radius:99px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap}
.bd-AK{background:#e0ebff;color:#123d9f}.bd-A{background:#dff3fb;color:#0a6f8a}.bd-K{background:#e0f5ea;color:#0e7a47}
.note{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;margin-top:14px;padding:14px 16px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--hl);border:1px solid var(--line);font-size:13px}.note p{margin:0 0 4px}
.ni{flex:none;width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--pri);color:#fff;font:italic 700 14px serif;display:grid;place-items:center}
.total{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:18px;padding:20px 24px;border-radius:14px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#123d9f,#1d5fd6);color:#fff}
.tt1{font:700 20px "Bricolage Grotesque",sans-serif}.total p{margin:4px 0 0;opacity:.9;font-size:13px}
.pill{background:#fff;color:#123d9f;font:700 clamp(20px,5vw,30px) "Bricolage Grotesque",sans-serif;padding:10px 22px;border-radius:99px}
@media (max-width:640px){.k4{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:8px}.total{padding:16px}.tt1{font-size:17px}.note{padding:12px}}
.ls{display:none}.kh{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:4px 12px;margin:22px 0 8px}.kt2{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font:700 17px "Bricolage Grotesque",sans-serif}.kt2 i{width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:4px;background:var(--kc)}.ks2{font-size:13px;color:var(--mute)}.pb:disabled{cursor:default;opacity:.85}@media (max-width:640px){.pre{display:block;width:max-content;margin-top:2px;font-size:10px;padding:1px 7px}}.na{color:var(--mute);opacity:.55}
.pg{padding:14px 18px;margin-bottom:14px}.pgh{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:8px}.pbar{height:10px;border-radius:5px;background:#dbe6fb;overflow:hidden}.pbar i{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:5px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#1d5fd6,#17a05d)}
.pm th.pc,.pm td.pc{text-align:center;padding-left:4px;padding-right:4px}.pm td.pc{white-space:nowrap}
.pb{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:7px;border:1.5px solid #b9c9e6;background:#fff;color:#fff;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;line-height:1;padding:0;cursor:pointer}.pb.on{background:var(--pri);border-color:var(--pri)}
tbody tr:nth-child(n):not(.tt):not(.aw) td.cm{background:var(--hl)}th.cm{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--th) 72%,#000)}
@media (max-width:859px){.lf{display:none}.ls{display:inline}}
@media (max-width:640px){.hm{display:none}.pb{width:22px;height:22px;font-size:12px}.pm th.pc,.pm td.pc{padding-left:2px;padding-right:2px}}
[hidden]{display:none!important}.wg .adm{display:none!important}
:root{--sb:#0a1d4a}
aside{color:#a9bde6;border-right:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0a1d4a,#0c2a6b)}.bn{color:#fff}
nav button:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08)}nav button[aria-selected=true]{background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);color:#fff;box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 #6fb1ff}.lnk{color:#fff}.mark{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#3b82f6,#22d3ee)}
.hero{--c1:#5aa2ff;--c2:#ff7a85;--c3:#3ddc97;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0a1d4a 0%,#12419b 55%,#2f80ff 100%);color:#fff;border:0;box-shadow:0 18px 40px -18px rgba(18,65,155,.65)}
.hero::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-70px;top:-90px;width:280px;height:280px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);pointer-events:none}
.hero .sub,.hero .tp{color:rgba(255,255,255,.78)}.hero .b.in{color:#7dffc4}.hero .b.out{color:#ffb3c0}.hero .big{text-shadow:none}
.hero .tl{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.22)}.hero .tl::before{opacity:1}
.tb{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:0 0 16px;font-size:13px}.tb .hi{margin-right:auto;font-weight:600;font-size:15px}.role{background:var(--hl);color:var(--pri);font-weight:600;padding:3px 11px;border-radius:99px}
.btn.sm{padding:6px 12px;font-size:13px}.tl .btn.sm{margin-top:8px}
.ri{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.ri:last-child{border:0}.ric{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:10px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:700;flex:none}.rm{flex:1;min-width:0}.rm b{display:block;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;font-size:14px}.ri>b{white-space:nowrap;font-size:14px}

.hero::after{animation:mFloat 14s ease-in-out infinite}
.btn{transition:transform .15s,box-shadow .15s,filter .15s}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 10px 18px -10px rgba(0,43,91,.55)}.btn:active{transform:none;box-shadow:none}
.kc,.tl{transition:transform .2s,border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s}.kc:hover,.tl:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}

}

function rng(ms){var ix=ms.map(function(m){return PMS.indexOf(m)}),runs=[],s0=0,i,nm=function(m){return BL[+m.slice(5)-1]};for(i=1;i<=ix.length;i++){if(i===ix.length||ix[i]!==ix[i-1]+1){runs.push(ms.slice(s0,i));s0=i}}return runs.map(function(r){return r.length>2?nm(r[0])+'–'+nm(r[r.length-1]):r.map(nm).join(', ')}).join(', ')}

 IW.forEach(function(w,i){if(ROLE!=='admin'&&i!==WID)return;var ms=[],qs={},a=0;ds.forEach(function(m){var c=cmp(w,m),u=0;QS3.forEach(function(q){if(c[q]>0&&!pdk(i,w,m,q)){u+=c[q];qs[q]=1}});if(u>0){ms.push(m);a+=u}});

 var own=ROLE!=='admin';return '<h2>'+(own?'Tunggakan Anda':'Pembayaran yang belum lunas')+'</h2>'+(rows.length?'<div class="panel tw"><table><thead><tr><th class="hm">No</th><th>Nama warga</th><th class="hm">Pos kas</th><th>Bulan belum dibayar</th><th class="n">Tunggakan</th><th class="adm">WhatsApp</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+rows.join('')+(own?'':'<tr class="tt"><td class="hm"></td><td>Total ('+rows.length+' warga)</td><td class="hm"></td><td></td><td class="n">'+cur(tot)+'</td><td class="adm"></td></tr>')+'</tbody></table></div>':'<div class="panel empty">'+(own?'Iuran Anda sudah lunas sampai ':'Semua warga sudah lunas sampai ')+bl(ds[ds.length-1])+'.</div>')}
function kasTable(q){
 var rs=[],sm2=PMS.map(function(){return [0,0,0,0]}),px=PMS.indexOf(PM),html;
 IW.forEach(function(w,i){if(PMS.some(function(m){return cmp(w,m)[q]>0}))rs.push([i,w])});
 html=rs.map(function(x){var i=x[0],w=x[1],mx=0;PMS.forEach(function(m){mx=Math.max(mx,cmp(w,m)[q])});

 '<div class="panel tw"><table class="pm" style="--th:'+KH[q]+';--tt:linear-gradient(90deg,color-mix(in srgb,'+KH[q]+' 60%,#000),'+KH[q]+');--hl:color-mix(in srgb,'+KH[q]+' 12%,#fff)"><thead><tr><th class="hm">No</th><th>Nama warga</th><th class="n hm">Iuran</th>'+PMS.map(function(m){return '<th class="pc'+(m===PM?' cm':'')+'">'+sm(m)+'</th>'}).join('')+'</tr></thead><tbody>'+html+
 '<tr class="tt"><td class="hm"></td><td>Terkumpul</td><td class="hm"></td>'+sm2.map(function(x){return '<td class="pc">'+lb(x[1])+'</td>'}).join('')+'</tr>'+

function nowM(){return new Date().toISOString().slice(0,7)}

function invLoad(){if(!REMOTE){S.inv=S.inv||[];INV=S.inv;return Promise.resolve()}return sb.from('pembayaran').select('*').order('id').then(function(r){if(r.data)INV=r.data})}
function invAdd(rec){if(REMOTE)return sb.from('pembayaran').insert({warga_idx:rec.warga_idx,bulan:rec.bulan,rincian:rec.rincian,jumlah:rec.jumlah,bukti:rec.bukti,metode:rec.metode,status:'pending'}).select().single().then(function(r){if(r.error)throw r.error;INV.push(r.data);return r.data});S.inv=S.inv||[];rec.id=S.inv.reduce(function(m,x){return Math.max(m,x.id)},0)+1;S.inv.push(rec);INV=S.inv;save();return Promise.resolve(rec)}

function pendM(i){var o={};INV.forEach(function(r){if(r.warga_idx===i&&r.status==='pending')r.bulan.forEach(function(m){o[m]=1})});return o}

function invTable(list,adm){if(!list.length)return '<div class="panel empty">Belum ada riwayat pembayaran.</div>';return '<div class="panel tw"><table><thead><tr><th>Tanggal</th>'+(adm?'<th>Nama warga</th>':'')+'<th>Bulan</th><th>Metode</th><th class="n">Jumlah</th><th>Status</th><th>Aksi</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+list.slice().reverse().map(function(r){var ac='';if(r.status==='paid')ac='<button class="btn sm" data-kw="'+r.id+'">Kwitansi</button>';if(adm&&r.status==='pending')ac='<button class="btn sm" data-act="inv-ok" data-id="'+r.id+'">Konfirmasi</button> <button class="btn ghost sm" data-act="inv-no" data-id="'+r.id+'">Tolak</button>';if(r.bukti)ac+=' <button class="btn ghost sm" data-ib="'+r.id+'">Bukti</button>';if(adm&&r.status!=='pending')ac+=' <button class="btn ghost sm" data-act="inv-del" data-id="'+r.id+'">Hapus</button>';return '<tr><td>'+tgi(r.created_at)+'</td>'+(adm?'<td>'+esc(IW[r.warga_idx][0])+'</td>':'')+'<td>'+r.bulan.map(bl).join(', ')+'</td><td>'+(r.metode==='tunai'?'Tunai':'Transfer')+'</td><td class="n b">'+cur(r.jumlah)+'</td><td>'+stBd(r.status)+'</td><td>'+ac+'</td></tr>'}).join('')+'</tbody></table></div>'}

  return h+'<h2>Catat pembayaran tunai</h2><div class="panel" style="padding:14px"><select data-aw style="width:100%;padding:10px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--line)">'+op+'</select></div>'+(ml?(ml.n?'<div class="panel" style="margin-top:10px">'+ml.rows+'</div><div class="panel sumb"><div class="gt"><span>Total tunai diterima</span><b>'+rp(ml.sub)+'</b></div><button class="btn" data-act="adm-tunai"'+(ml.sub?'':' disabled')+'>Catat &amp; terbitkan kwitansi</button></div>':'<div class="panel empty">Warga ini tidak punya iuran yang perlu dibayar.</div>'):'')+'<h2>Menunggu konfirmasi</h2>'+invTable(INV.filter(function(r){return r.status==='pending'}),true)+'<h2>Riwayat pembayaran</h2>'+invTable(INV.filter(function(r){return r.status!=='pending'}),true)+'<h2>Hapus semua data pembayaran warga</h2><div class="panel" style="padding:14px;display:grid;gap:10px"><select data-dw style="width:100%;padding:10px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--line)">'+wopts()+'</select><button class="btn ghost" data-act="wipe">Hapus semua pembayaran warga ini</button><small style="color:var(--mute)">Menghapus status lunas, catatan pemasukan di Buku kas, dan riwayat pembayaran warga yang dipilih, sehingga Ringkasan, Iuran warga, dan Laporan ikut berubah.</small></div>'}

 return h+'<h2>Iuran yang bisa dibayar</h2>'+(ml2.n?'<div class="panel">'+ml2.rows+'</div><div class="panel sumb"><div class="gt"><span>Total bayar</span><b>'+rp(ml2.sub)+'</b></div><button class="btn" data-act="bayar-konfirm"'+(ml2.sub?'':' disabled')+'>Bayar iuran</button></div>':'<div class="panel empty">Tidak ada iuran yang perlu dibayar saat ini.</div>')+'<h2>Riwayat pembayaran Anda</h2>'+invTable(INV.filter(function(r){return r.warga_idx===WID}),false)+'<div class="note"><span class="ni">i</span><div><p>Pembayaran lewat transfer atau tunai berstatus lunas setelah dikonfirmasi pengurus. function payConfirm(r){var P2=S.pay=S.pay||{},td=new Date().toISOString(),nm=IW[r.warga_idx][0].replace(/\*+$/,''),nx=S.trx.reduce(function(m,x){return Math.max(m,x.id)},0),ids=[],mt=r.metode==='tunai'?'tunai':'transfer';
 r.bulan.forEach(function(m){QS3.forEach(function(q){var a=(r.rincian[m]||{})[q]||0;if(a>0){P2[r.warga_idx+'|'+m+'|'+q]=1;ids.push(++nx);S.trx.push({id:nx,kas:q,tgl:td.slice(0,10),j:'m',ket:P[q]+nm+' bulan '+bl(m)+' ('+mt+')',amt:a})}})});

function invDel(r){var undo=function(){if(r.status==='paid'){var ids=(r.rincian&&r.rincian._trx)||[],nm=IW[r.warga_idx][0].replace(/\*+$/,''),n=0,rm=0;if(ids.length){var b4=S.trx.length;S.trx=S.trx.filter(function(x){return ids.indexOf(x.id)<0});rm=b4-S.trx.length}
  r.bulan.forEach(function(m){QS3.forEach(function(q){var a=(r.rincian[m]||{})[q]||0;if(a>0){n++;if(S.pay)delete S.pay[r.warga_idx+'|'+m+'|'+q]}})});
  if(rm<n){r.bulan.forEach(function(m){QS3.forEach(function(q){var a=(r.rincian[m]||{})[q]||0;if(a>0&&rm<n){var k=P[q]+nm+' bulan '+bl(m),ix=S.trx.findIndex(function(x){return x.kas===q&&x.amt===a&&String(x.ket).indexOf(k)===0});if(ix>-1){S.trx.splice(ix,1);rm++}}})})}}
  if(!REMOTE){S.inv.splice(S.inv.indexOf(r),1);INV=S.inv}else INV=INV.filter(function(y){return y!==r});save();render();toast('Pembayaran dihapus');if(REMOTE)invLoad().then(render)};
 if(REMOTE)return sb.from('pembayaran').delete().eq('id',r.id).select().then(function(x){if(x.error||!x.data||!x.data.length)toast('Gagal menghapus di database. Pastikan pembayaran.sql sudah dijalankan.');else undo()});undo()}

 if(!confirm('Hapus SEMUA data pembayaran '+nm+'?\n\n- '+pk.length+' status lunas dikembalikan menjadi belum lunas\n- '+tx.length+' catatan pemasukan di Buku kas dihapus\n- '+iv.length+' riwayat pembayaran dihapus\n\nTidak bisa dibatalkan.'))return;

 if(REMOTE)sb.from('pembayaran').delete().eq('warga_idx',i).select().then(function(x){if(x.error)toast('Riwayat di database gagal dihapus; data lain sudah dihapus');fin()});else fin()}

 d.innerHTML='<h2>Catat transaksi</h2><div class="fg"><label>Kas<select id="fk">'+K.map(function(k){return '<option value="'+k+'"'+(k===kas?' selected':'')+'>'+NM[k]+'</option>'}).join('')+'</select></label><label>Jenis<select id="fj"></select></label><label>Tanggal<input id="ft" type="date" min="2026-07-01" value="'+td+'"></label><label>Jumlah (Rp)<input id="fn" type="number" min="0" step="1000" inputmode="numeric"><small id="fh"></small></label><label class="w">Keterangan<input id="fe" placeholder="Contoh: Iuran Kas Air Bp Budi bulan November 2026"></label><label class="w">Bukti transaksi (foto struk, opsional)<input id="fb" type="file" accept="image/*"></label></div><div class="da"><button class="btn ghost" data-act="cancel">Batal</button><button class="btn" data-act="save">Simpan transaksi</button></div>';

document.addEventListener('click',function(e){
 var g=e.target.closest('g[data-m]');if(g){ym=g.getAttribute('data-m');render();return}var t=e.target.closest('button');if(!t)return;var d=t.dataset;

 if(d.lr){LR=d.lr;document.querySelectorAll('[data-lr]').forEach(function(b){b.setAttribute('aria-selected',b.dataset.lr===LR)});document.getElementById('lw').hidden=LR!=='w';document.getElementById('lmw').hidden=!(REMOTE&&LR==='a');var lf=document.getElementById('lf');if(lf)lf.hidden=LR==='w';return}
 if(d.act==='login'){if(REMOTE){var em=LR==='a'?document.getElementById('lm').value.trim():wmail(+document.getElementById('ln').value);sb.auth.signInWithPassword({email:em,password:document.getElementById('lp').value}).then(function(r){if(r.error){document.getElementById('le').textContent=(LR==='a'?'Email atau kata sandi salah.':'PIN salah.');return}return enter()});return}var ok=LR==='a'?((S.pin&&S.pin.a)||'1234'):wpin(+document.getElementById('ln').value);if(document.getElementById('lp').value!==ok){document.getElementById('le').textContent='PIN salah. Coba lagi.';return}
  ROLE=LR==='a'?'admin':'warga';WID=LR==='w'?+document.getElementById('ln').value:-1;try{localStorage.setItem('gm-sess',JSON.stringify({r:LR,w:WID}))}catch(x){}tab='ringkasan';render();return}
 if(d.act==='forgot'){var fm=document.getElementById('lm').value.trim(),fe=document.getElementById('le');if(!fm){fe.textContent='Isi email terlebih dahulu.';return}sb.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(fm,{redirectTo:location.href.split('#')[0]}).then(function(r){fe.textContent=r.error?'Gagal mengirim email reset.':'Tautan reset kata sandi dikirim ke email Anda.'});return}
 if(d.act==='logout'){if(REMOTE)sb.auth.signOut();try{localStorage.removeItem('gm-sess')}catch(x){}ROLE=null;WID=-1;render();return}
 if(d.act==='pin'){openPin();return}
 if(d.act==='pinsave'&&REMOTE){var v6=/^.{6,64}$/,er6=function(m){document.getElementById('pe').textContent=m},n6=document.getElementById('pn').value,c6=document.getElementById('pc').value;
  if(!v6.test(n6)){er6('Kata sandi baru minimal 6 karakter');return}if(n6!==c6){er6('Ulangi kata sandi baru tidak sama');return}
  var go6=function(){sb.auth.updateUser({password:n6}).then(function(u){if(u.error){er6('Gagal mengubah kata sandi');return}RECOV=false;document.getElementById('dlg').close();toast('Kata sandi disimpan')})};
  if(ROLE==='admin'||RECOV)go6();else sb.auth.getUser().then(function(u){return sb.auth.signInWithPassword({email:u.data.user.email,password:document.getElementById('po').value})}).then(function(r){if(r.error){er6('Kata sandi lama salah');return}go6()});return}
 if(d.act==='pinsave'){var v=/^\d{4,8}$/,er=function(m){document.getElementById('pe').textContent=m};
  if(ROLE==='admin'){var a=document.getElementById('pa').value,w=document.getElementById('pw').value,r=document.getElementById('pr').value;if((a&&!v.test(a))||(w&&!v.test(w))){er('PIN harus 4 sampai 8 angka');return}S.pin=S.pin||{};if(a)S.pin.a=a;if(w)S.pin.w=w;if(r!==''&&S.wp)delete S.wp[IW[+r][0]]}
  else{var o=document.getElementById('po').value,n=document.getElementById('pn').value,c=document.getElementById('pc').value;if(o!==wpin(WID)){er('PIN lama salah');return}if(!v.test(n)){er('PIN baru harus 4 sampai 8 angka');return}if(n!==c){er('Ulangi PIN baru tidak sama');return}S.wp=S.wp||{};S.wp[IW[WID][0]]=n}
  save();document.getElementById('dlg').close();toast('PIN disimpan');return}
 if(d.dl){if(d.dl==='xls')xls();else pdf(d.dl==='pdf1'?ym:null);return}
 if(d.bk){showBukti(+d.bk)}
});

<script>
(function(){
var rm=window.matchMedia&&matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)').matches,last='',tm;
function count(el){
 if(el.children.length)return;var m=el.textContent.trim().match(/^(\D*?)(\d[\d.]*)(\D*)$/);
 if(!m||/,/.test(m[2]))return;var to=parseInt(m[2].replace(/\./g,''),10);if(!(to>0))return;
 var t0=performance.now(),d=900;
 (function f(t){var p=Math.min(1,(t-t0)/d),e=1-Math.pow(1-p,3);
  el.textContent=m[1]+Math.round(to*e).toLocaleString('id-ID')+m[3];
  if(p<1)requestAnimationFrame(f)})(t0);
}
function go(){
 if(rm)return;var a=document.getElementById('app');if(!a||!a.firstChild)return;
 var k=[window.tab,window.kas,window.ym].join('|');if(k===last)return;last=k;
 a.classList.remove('pg-in');void a.offsetWidth;a.classList.add('pg-in');
 clearTimeout(tm);tm=setTimeout(function(){a.classList.remove('pg-in')},1600);
 a.querySelectorAll('.hero .big,.ks,.tl b,.pill').forEach(count);
}
var r0=window.render;
if(typeof r0==='function'){window.render=function(){var x=r0.apply(this,arguments);go();return x};}
go();
})();
</script>
<style id="ai-fab">
#ai{position:fixed;right:20px;bottom:calc(20px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));z-index:30;width:58px;height:58px;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid #fcb017;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#003d79,#002b5b);padding:0;cursor:pointer;display:grid;place-items:center;box-shadow:0 12px 24px -10px rgba(0,43,91,.7);transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s}
#ai:hover{transform:translateY(-3px) scale(1.05)}#ai svg{width:34px;height:34px}
#aip{position:fixed;right:20px;bottom:calc(90px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));z-index:30;width:min(300px,calc(100vw - 32px));background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-top:4px solid #fcb017;border-radius:18px;padding:16px;box-shadow:0 24px 48px -20px rgba(0,43,91,.55)}
#aip[hidden]{display:none}
#aip b{display:block;color:#002b5b;font-size:15px;margin-bottom:2px}#aip p{margin:0 0 12px;font-size:13px;color:var(--mute)}
#aip .ql{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
#aip .ql button{text-align:left;background:var(--hl);color:#003d79;border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer}
#aip .ql button:hover{background:#dbe7f6}
body:has(#lg:not([hidden])) #ai,body:has(#lg:not([hidden])) #aip{display:none}
@media (max-width:859px){#ai{bottom:calc(84px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));right:14px;width:54px;height:54px}#aip{bottom:calc(150px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));right:14px}}
@media print{#ai,#aip{display:none!important}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){
@keyframes aiFloat{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-5px)}}
@keyframes aiBlink{0%,92%,100%{transform:scaleY(1)}96%{transform:scaleY(.1)}}
@keyframes aiPop{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px) scale(.96)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
#ai{animation:aiFloat 3.6s ease-in-out infinite}#ai:hover{animation:none}
#ai .ey{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center;animation:aiBlink 5s infinite}
#aip:not([hidden]){animation:aiPop .25s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) both}}
#aip{width:min(340px,calc(100vw - 32px));padding:0;overflow:hidden}
#aip .ah{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#003d79,#002b5b);color:#fff;padding:12px 16px}#aip .ah b{color:#fff;margin:0}#aip .ah small{display:block;font-size:12px;color:#b7c9e3}
#aip .am{max-height:min(38vh,260px);overflow-y:auto;padding:12px 14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;background:#f7f9fc}
#aip .m{max-width:88%;padding:9px 12px;border-radius:14px;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.45;white-space:pre-wrap;word-wrap:break-word}
#aip .m.a{align-self:flex-start;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--ink);border-bottom-left-radius:4px}
#aip .m.u{align-self:flex-end;background:#003d79;color:#fff;border-bottom-right-radius:4px}
#aip .m.ty{color:var(--mute);letter-spacing:2px}
#aip .aq{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;padding:8px 14px 0}
#aip .aq button{background:#fff4d9;color:#6b4500;border:1px solid #f6dfaa;border-radius:99px;padding:6px 11px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer}
#aip .af{display:flex;gap:8px;padding:10px 14px}#aip .af input{flex:1;min-height:40px;border-radius:12px;font-size:14px}#aip .af .btn{min-height:40px}
#aip .al{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;padding:0 14px 12px}#aip .al button{background:var(--hl);color:#003d79;border:0;border-radius:99px;padding:5px 10px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer}
#aip .al span{width:100%;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--mute)}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){@keyframes aiDot{0%,100%{opacity:.35}50%{opacity:1}}#aip .m.ty{animation:aiDot 1s infinite}}
</style>
<button id="ai" type="button" aria-label="Asisten AI" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="aip"><svg viewBox="0 0 40 40" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 5v5" stroke="#fcb017" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="20" cy="4.5" r="2.4" fill="#fcb017"/><rect x="7" y="11" width="26" height="21" rx="7" fill="#fff"/><rect x="3" y="18" width="3.5" height="7" rx="1.75" fill="#fcb017"/><rect x="33.5" y="18" width="3.5" height="7" rx="1.75" fill="#fcb017"/><rect x="10.5" y="14.5" width="19" height="14" rx="4.5" fill="#002b5b"/><ellipse class="ey" cx="15.5" cy="20.5" rx="2.4" ry="2.8" fill="#fcb017"/><ellipse class="ey" cx="24.5" cy="20.5" rx="2.4" ry="2.8" fill="#fcb017"/><path d="M16.5 25.2c2 1.4 5 1.4 7 0" stroke="#fcb017" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg></button>
<div id="aip" role="dialog" aria-label="Asisten AI" hidden><div class="ah"><b>Asisten Griya Mulya</b><small>Tanya soal kas dan iuran</small></div><div id="aim" class="am" aria-live="polite"></div><div id="aq" class="aq"></div><form id="aif" class="af"><input id="ai-in" maxlength="300" placeholder="Tulis pertanyaan…" autocomplete="off" aria-label="Pertanyaan"><button type="submit" class="btn sm" id="ai-go">Kirim</button></form><div class="al"><span>Buka menu:</span><button type="button" data-tab="ringkasan">Ringkasan</button><button type="button" data-tab="buku">Buku kas</button><button type="button" data-tab="iuran">Iuran</button><button type="button" data-tab="bayar">Pembayaran</button><button type="button" data-tab="lapor">Laporan</button></div></div>
<script>
(function(){
var AI_URL=/netlify\.app$/.test(location.hostname)?'/.netlify/functions/ai':'https://vriya-perum-gm.netlify.app/.netlify/functions/ai';
var b=document.getElementById('ai'),p=document.getElementById('aip'),m=document.getElementById('aim'),f=document.getElementById('aif'),inp=document.getElementById('ai-in'),go=document.getElementById('ai-go'),q=document.getElementById('aq'),H=[],busy=false,who='';
function add(role,t){var d=document.createElement('div');d.className='m '+(role==='user'?'u':'a');d.textContent=t;m.appendChild(d);m.scrollTop=m.scrollHeight;return d}
function ctx(){
 var now=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10),cm=now.slice(0,7),adm=ROLE==='admin',o={tanggal_hari_ini:now,peran:adm?'admin':'warga',bulan_terbuka:bl(ym),jumlah_kk:IW.length};
 if(!adm)o.nama_warga=IW[WID][0].replace(/\*+$/,'');
 o.saldo_per_bulan=months().map(function(x){var t=tot(x);return{bulan:bl(x),saldo_awal:t.awal,pemasukan:t.mi,uang_air:t.ua,pengeluaran:t.ko,saldo_akhir:t.akhir}});
 o.saldo_per_kas_bulan_terbuka={};K.forEach(function(k){var s=st(k,ym);o.saldo_per_kas_bulan_terbuka[NM[k]]={saldo_awal:s.awal,pemasukan:s.mi,uang_air:s.ua,pengeluaran:s.ko,saldo_akhir:s.akhir}});
 o.transaksi_bulan_terbuka=S.trx.filter(function(x){return x.tgl.slice(0,7)===ym}).slice(-40).map(function(x){return{tgl:x.tgl,kas:NM[x.kas],jenis:x.j==='m'?'pemasukan':x.j==='k'?'pengeluaran':'uang air (bukan pemasukan)',ket:x.ket,jumlah:x.amt}});
 var tg=[];IW.forEach(function(w,i){if(!adm&&i!==WID)return;var bel=[],jt=0;PMS.forEach(function(mm){if(mm>cm)return;var c=cmp(w,mm),bi=0;QS3.forEach(function(k){if(c[k]>0&&!pdk(i,w,mm,k))bi+=c[k]});if(bi>0){bel.push(bl(mm));jt+=bi}});if(bel.length)tg.push({nama:w[0].replace(/\*+$/,''),bulan_belum_lunas:bel,total_tunggakan:jt})});
 o.tunggakan_iuran=tg;o.catatan_tunggakan='Daftar kosong berarti semua iuran sampai bulan ini sudah lunas.';
 return o}
function start(){
 var w=ROLE+'|'+WID;if(w===who)return;who=w;H=[];m.innerHTML='';q.innerHTML='';q.hidden=false;
 add('assistant','Halo! Saya asisten AI Griya Mulya. Saya bisa menjawab soal saldo kas, transaksi, dan iuran berdasarkan data di website ini. Jawaban AI bisa keliru, jadi untuk angka penting cek juga di menu Buku kas atau Iuran.');
 var qs=ROLE==='admin'?[['Berapa saldo kas bulan ini?','Saldo kas bulan ini'],['Siapa saja yang belum membayar iuran?','Siapa belum bayar?'],['Apa saja pengeluaran bulan ini?','Pengeluaran bulan ini']]:[['Apakah iuran saya sudah lunas?','Iuran saya lunas?'],['Berapa saldo kas bulan ini?','Saldo kas bulan ini'],['Apa saja pengeluaran bulan ini?','Pengeluaran bulan ini']];
 qs.forEach(function(x){var e=document.createElement('button');e.type='button';e.setAttribute('data-ai-q',x[0]);e.textContent=x[1];q.appendChild(e)})}
function ask(t){
 t=(t||'').trim();if(!t||busy)return;
 if(!REMOTE||!sb){add('user',t);add('assistant','Asisten AI hanya aktif di versi online website ini.');return}
 busy=true;go.disabled=true;q.hidden=true;add('user',t);H.push({role:'user',content:t});
 var w=add('assistant','•••');w.classList.add('ty');
 sb.auth.getSession().then(function(r){var s=r.data&&r.data.session;if(!s)throw new Error('401');
  return fetch(AI_URL,{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json',Authorization:'Bearer '+s.access_token},body:JSON.stringify({messages:H.slice(-10),context:ctx()})})})
 .then(function(r){if(r.status===401)throw new Error('401');if(!r.ok)throw new Error('err');return r.json()})
 .then(function(j){var a=(j.reply||'').trim()||'Maaf, saya belum bisa menjawab itu.';w.classList.remove('ty');w.textContent=a;H.push({role:'assistant',content:a})})
 .catch(function(e){w.classList.remove('ty');w.textContent=e.message==='401'?'Sesi Anda berakhir. Silakan keluar lalu masuk lagi.':'Asisten sedang tidak tersedia. Coba lagi sebentar lagi.';H.pop()})
 .then(function(){busy=false;go.disabled=false;m.scrollTop=m.scrollHeight})}
function set(o){p.hidden=!o;b.setAttribute('aria-expanded',o);if(o){start();setTimeout(function(){inp.focus()},60)}}
b.addEventListener('click',function(){set(p.hidden)});
f.addEventListener('submit',function(e){e.preventDefault();var v=inp.value;inp.value='';ask(v)});
q.addEventListener('click',function(e){var x=e.target.closest('[data-ai-q]');if(x)ask(x.getAttribute('data-ai-q'))});
document.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(e.target.closest('#ai'))return;if(e.target.closest('#aip')){if(e.target.closest('[data-tab]'))set(false);return}set(false)});
document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Escape')set(false)});
})();
</script>
